 Flood situation in Hilir Perak improves

 Sunday, 15 Nov 2026
 | 6:16 PM MYT

 IPOH: The number of flash flood victims in Hilir Perak has dropped.
 According to the state disaster management committee, 191 people from 59 families are still seeking shelter at the Teluk Intan Municipal Council Rest House's hall as of Sunday (Nov 15) at 4pm.
 There were about 350 people seeking shelter at two temporary relief centres earlier on Tuesday (Nov 10).
 Kampung Batu 6, Kampung Batu 7, Kampung Batu 8, Kampung Batu 9 and Kampung Batu 10 in Changkat Jong are the areas still affected by the flood.
 According to the Meteorological Department, thunderstorms are expected tonight in all districts in Perak.
